Quick guide to getting the most out of Claude for business:

1. ALWAYS set context first
Start every important chat with: 'I run [BUSINESS]. My audience is [AUDIENCE]. My tone is [VOICE]. Remember this for all responses in this conversation.'

2. Be specific about format
Don't say 'write a post.' Say 'write a 150-word LinkedIn post with a stat in the first line, 3 bullet points, and a question at the end.'

3. Give examples of what you like
'Here's an example of writing I love: [PASTE]. Match this style.'

4. Iterate, don't regenerate
'This is good. Now make it 30% shorter and add a stronger CTA at the end.'

5. Use the meta-prompt when stuck
'This prompt isn't working: [PASTE]. Fix it to produce: [WHAT YOU WANT].'

This approach turns every Claude interaction into a 10-minute task instead of an hour of trial and error.
